findings.situation: A filer received nonqualified deferred compensation or nongovernmental section 457 plan income that is included in box 1 of their Form W-2 or box 1 of Form 1099-NEC, but the employer or payer did not show it in W-2 box 11, in W-2 box 12 with code Z, or in box 15 of Form 1099-MISC.
findings.source_text: i1040gi p. 95, Line 20, item 5: "If you received income from a nonqualified deferred compensation plan or nongovernmental section 457 plan that is included in box 1 of your Form W-2, or in box 1 of Form 1099-NEC, don't include that income on line 8 of the worksheet. The income should be shown in (a) box 11 ... If it isn't, contact your employer or the payer for the amount of the income."
findings.why: The text triggers the special case when the income is included in box 1 of the W-2 or 1099-NEC, whether or not it is shown in the other boxes. The question defines the income only as 'an amount in box 11 ... box 12 with code Z, or in box 15 of Form 1099-MISC'. A filer whose forms leave those boxes blank would answer no, so the return is not refused even though the worksheet's line 8 would overstate compensation.
